document.abstract: The “motor boat” effect it a spurious signal of low frequency caused by a defect in sound printing operations. One of the principal causes is abrasion or pressure marks caused by the perforations of the negative coming in contact with the print stock. A method of modifying a 16mm motion-picture printer to avoid this defect it described.
